schema.title: Response List Moods Api V1 Moods Get

get.description:
List active entries; reversed, expired or future date ranges return INVALID_RANGE.

Range bounds follow the current account timezone. An entry retains the timezone captured at
creation, including after the account timezone changes or the entry is edited.

parameters.name: from

schema.description: Inclusive start within the current account-local 90-day window; defaults to today minus 89 days.
schema.title: From

parameters.description: Inclusive start within the current account-local 90-day window; defaults to today minus 89 days.

parameters.name: to

schema.description: Inclusive end within the current account-local 90-day window; defaults to today.
schema.title: To

parameters.description: Inclusive end within the current account-local 90-day window; defaults to today.
